user.title: Connect to Norsup Smartpool
user.description: Enter your Smart Pool Connect credentials for one pool. See INSTALL.md (Obtaining an API key) for how to get your API key.

data_description.api_key: Long-lived token from Smart Pool Connect. See INSTALL.md → Obtaining an API key.
data_description.pool_id: UUID from the portal URL when you open your pool (INSTALL.md → Finding your Pool ID).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Smart Pool Connect. Check your network and base URL.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid API key or pool ID. Verify credentials in the Smart Pool Connect portal.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check Home Assistant logs for details.

init.title: Update Norsup Smartpool options
init.description: Rotate your API key or change the poll interval. The new key is validated before saving.

data.enable_diagnostics: Enable diagnostics sensor (reload integration after change)
